    Sample of Raw Data

    raw_data.Rd

    Sample of raw data used for testing.

    raw_data

    Format

    An object of class tbl_df (inherits from tbl, data.frame)

    Examples

    head(raw_data)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 58
#>   chemical_name    test_cas test_id result_id endpoint effect effect_description
#>   <chr>               <dbl>   <dbl>     <dbl> <chr>    <chr>  <chr>

#> 2 1,1,2-Trichloro…    79016 1180405     96318 LC50     MOR    Mortality         
#> 3 1,3,4,6,7,8-Hex…  1222055 2201619   2405020 NOEL     ACC    Accumulation      
#> 4 2,3,4,5,6-Penta…    87865 1321919    780907 LOEL     HRM    Hormone(s)        
#> 5 2-(4-Chlorophen…   637070 2246403   2535987 NOEC     BCM    Biochemistry      
#> 6 2-[(3,5,6-Trich… 57213691 1200760    250346 NOEC     POP    Population        
#> # ℹ 51 more variables: conc1_mean <chr>, conc1_unit <chr>,
